note: Small treed campground 45 km north of Nordegg on the Forestry Trunk Road (Hwy 734), managed by West Fraser and the Fox Creek Development Association, with sites on a short loop beside Brown Creek. Free firewood; the hand pump is for putting out fires only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Aug 6, 2026) and West Fraser's page: C$20 unserviced (C$15 senior's rate per the operator), first-come, season May 1 - Oct 31 (derived -> manual), vault toilet, non-potable pump; sites 8 (operator + tear sheet; the AP table says 7). Not waterfront kept, with a creekside lead. Phone 780-865-2154 suggested.
flags: PHONE (stored empty): the page's 'Information: 780-865-2154'. 'Facility Operator: West Fraser Mills-Fox Creek Development Association'; West Fraser's page gives only an e-mail contact (no phone). Recommend 780-865-2154.

WEBSITE: the stored Alberta Parks camping page answered 200 and is this campground. Operator page (200, this campground): https://www.westfraser.com/responsibility/recreation/frma/campgrounds/brown-creek-campground - could be added as a second line.
SITES: AP table 'Unserviced 7'; West Fraser 'eight sites' and the tear sheet (Feb 2025) numbers 1-8. Wrote 8.
SENIORS LINE: PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.'); the operator states the figure: '$15/night Senior's Rate'. Not in the provincial:AB row.

OHV: the page and the operator list 'OHV trails (outside the recreation area)' among area activities. The campground itself is not described as on or at the trailhead of an OHV system; not a drop candidate on the wording.

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored not waterfront; no change - never upgrade): the stored evidence ('sites up by the access road set back ... across an open/willow flat (~80-150m)') does not match the tear sheet or imagery. The tear sheet puts the 8-site loop in the bend of Brown Creek with sites 2-5 on its south/west side; on Esri imagery the loop's spurs sit in a spruce stand whose south edge is ~20-30 m from the braided channel (channel ~10-20 m wide = creek, not river), with a gravel bar and a fringe of spruce between. The pads themselves are under the trees, so water at the pads is not established; a reviewer may consider creekside/creekview for sites 2-5 on site photos. Recommend keeping not waterfront unless such photos show open ground to the water.
PIN (52.76369,-116.36260): inside the site loop, matches the page's directions point 52.763688,-116.362603. No move.
